summary: Iteration 38 - Comprehensive testing of Easter Egg Tracker, Daily Laugh Goal, Category Hierarchy, AI Newsletter Optimization, and Premium Map Export. All 29 backend tests passed. Fixed 2 bugs: 1) Easter egg leaderboard async/await issue, 2) LaughProvider not wrapping App. All features verified working.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 38 are working. Easter Egg Tracker shows 15 eggs with rarity system. Daily Laugh Goal has streak bonuses (3/7/14/30/100 days). Category hierarchy supports deep nesting with cascade delete. AI Newsletter Optimization returns fallback recommendations when LLM key not configured. Map export buttons (CSV/JSON) are present.

details.GET_daily_laugh_goal: Returns goal, progress, streak, longest_streak, goal_completed_today

details.GET_categories: Returns categories with result_count and subcategory_count
details.POST_create: Creates parent or subcategory with level calculation
details.DELETE_cascade: Deletes category and all children recursively

details.GET_ai_optimize: Returns AI recommendations or fallback when LLM not configured

details.CSV_Export: Button present, exports map data as CSV
details.JSON_Export: Button present, exports map data as JSON
